system.description: you learn two of the four Fighter Manoeuvres (see Combat Manoeuvres, below), and the other two at 9th. Each is used once per round, on a hit, and improves at 15th.

activities.name: Intimidating Strike
activities.text: On a hit: the target makes a Will save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.{15: Every enemy within 5ft of you saves.}

activities.name: Drive Back
activities.text: On a hit: push the target {1:5ft, 15:10ft} and step into the space it left.

activities.name: Bar the Way
activities.text: On a hit: until your next turn, the target can't move past you without a Reflex save.{15: Nor can any enemy within 5ft of you.}

activities.name: Feint and Strike
activities.text: On a hit: your next attack against the target this round has Advantage.{15: So does an ally's next attack against it.}
